name: cross
comment: MATLAB cross — vector cross product. Vector form [1 2 3]x[4 5 6]=[-3 6 -3]; column-wise on a 3x3 matrix (cross of corresponding columns). COMPLEX: ordinary cross product, NO conjugation: cross([1+1i 0 0],[0 1 0])=[0 0 1+1i]; cross([1i;2;3],[4;5i;6])=[12-15i;12-6i;-13]. numkit previously threw 'Not a double array' on COMPLEX (added 2026-05-29). Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b.
